  const draw = (id, d) => set(id, "d", d);

  function morph(from, to, amount) {
    const coordinates = to.match(/-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g).map(Number);
    let index = 0;
    return from.replace(/-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?/g, value =>
      round(mix(Number(value), coordinates[index++], amount))

  }

  function bend(path, map) {
    return path.replace(/(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?) (-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/g, (_, x, y) => {
      const [nextX, nextY] = map(Number(x), Number(y));
      return `${round(nextX)} ${round(nextY)}`;

  function tangent(before, after) {
    return before * after <= 0 ? 0 : 2 * before * after / (before + after);

      const u2 = u * u;
      const u3 = u2 * u;
      return track[i].map((a, j) => {
        const b = track[i + 1][j];
        const delta = b - a;
        const start = tangent(a - track[Math.max(0, i - 1)][j], delta);
        const end = tangent(delta, track[Math.min(7, i + 2)][j] - b);
        return a + (3 * u2 - 2 * u3) * delta +

    }

    move("writing-arm-light", writeX * .32, writeY * .3);

    set("left-pencil", "transform", `rotate(${pencilAngle} 35 198)`);

    const [headX, headY, rightEyeX, rightEyeY, rightMouthX, rightMouthY, mouthHeight] =

    move("right-head", headX, headY);
    move("right-inner-eye", rightEyeX, rightEyeY);
    move("right-mouth", rightMouthX, rightMouthY,
      `translate(0 90) scale(1 ${mouthHeight}) translate(0 -90)`);
    draw("right-torso-profile", bend(paths.rightTorso, (x, y) => {
      const weight = clamp((144 - y) / 65) * clamp((226 - x) / 96);
      return [x + headX * weight, y + headY * weight];
    }));

    const [farX, farY, farAngle] = sample(tracks.farHand);
    move("right-far-hand", farX, farY, `rotate(${farAngle} 99 112)`);
    draw("right-far-sleeve", bend(paths.rightFarArm, (x, y) => {
      const weight = clamp((139 - x) / 41);
      return [x + mix(.34 * headX, farX, weight), y + mix(headY, farY, weight)];
    }));

    const [rubX, rubY, rubAngle] = sample(tracks.rubbing);
    const flexEmbrace = (x, y) => {
      const weight = clamp((199 - x) / 84);
      return [x + rubX * weight, y + rubY * weight];

    draw("embracing-arm-profile", bend(paths.embracingArm, flexEmbrace));
    draw("embracing-arm-shadow", bend(paths.embracingShadow, flexEmbrace));
    draw("embracing-arm-edge", bend(paths.embracingEdge, flexEmbrace));
    move("embracing-arm-light", rubX * .43, rubY * .48, "rotate(-24 157 150)");
    move("right-embracing-hand", rubX, rubY, `rotate(${rubAngle} 116 173)`);
  }
